description:
Get one motion entry as a build prompt: what moves and how (every property, duration, easing
curve or spring, delay and trigger), why it feels good, what a rebuild must keep, Screenrove's
working vanilla HTML/CSS/JS implementation, and the original source code when its license
allows. Values are marked as exact (from code) or approximate (measured from a recording).

Use the numbers as given and translate the code to the project's stack.

code.description: Which code to include - both, vanilla (Screenrove rebuild), original (source library) or none.

motionId.description: Motion entry id from searchMotion, e.g. interior-copy-button.

name: get_motion

prompt.description: Markdown build prompt with spec and code.

title: Get one animation with its spec and code
